question: Does the second ability of It That Betrays trigger only when its annihilator forces a sacrifice?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it triggers whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent, for any reason.
expected.answer: The second ability triggers whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent for any reason, not just due to the annihilator ability.
